name: Grounded Paws Dog Walking and Pet Care LLC

reviews.text: We couldn't be happier with the care Meg provides for our two pups, Arnie and Molly. She is reliable, loving, and truly treats our dogs like her own. Arnie and Molly always come back from their walks happy and well-exercised. She always leave a little note for us and send us great photos. We highly recommend Meg!
reviews.author: Abbie O'Brien

reviews.text: Megan has watched both of our dogs multiple times and we couldn't be happier with the services she provides. She goes above and beyond what is required and treats our dogs like they are her own. Booking is seamless and her communication is great.  We highly recommend her and are grateful to have found her.
reviews.author: Mike Wessner

reviews.text: We hired Megan to care for our two greyhounds while we were traveling and we couldn’t have been happier with the service! We’ve never had anyone besides family watch our dogs and Megan put us at ease the entire trip. Prior to our trip, she took the time to visit with our pups and learn their mannerisms/routine/schedule. During the trip, she sent updates before, during, and after visits and even included photos and videos of the dogs. Our travel plans ended up being delayed and she swooped in to save the day by doing a few more visits! Megan is so good at what she does and you can tell she loves to do it! I cannot recommend her enough!!!
reviews.author: Jackie Barrett

reviews.text: We hired Megan to walk/check on our dog while we were away in the hospital having a baby, and then for walks for a couple months after while we settled into life post-baby. Megan took amazing care of our dog, was very professional, flexible, and easy to communicate and schedule with, and was exceptionally reliable. She had a personal emergency while we were at the hospital and still prioritized care of our dog since she knew we weren't home. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Aparna Chhibber

reviews.text: Grounded Paws certainly lives up to its name. Megan is a warm, nurturing & grounded presence with the insight to match each of my pet's unique needs & energy levels. She is patient, adaptable & reliable! My fur babies & I are all truly able to stay happy & healthy thanks to her services. Couldn't be happier! Absolutely recommend!!
reviews.author: Leah Friedman
